evidence_items.title: puzzling-bench/puzzling-bench
evidence_items.summary: Puzzling-Bench Puzzling-Bench is a benchmark of 23,777 human-written puzzles from Puzzling Stack Exchange, each paired with the answer its own author accepted. It covers riddles, ciphers, logic grids, lateral-thinking problems, wordplay and recreational mathematics posted between May 2014 and June 2026. On Puzzling Stack Exchange the asker almost always knows the solution and marks the correct answer, so the accepted answer serves as community-verified ground truth.
